note: Entry metric bands and the cohort average, by hand. Edges 8, 10, 12, 14 make five bands: below 8, then each interval closed below and open above, then 14 and over; 7.99 sits in the first, 8 in the second (an edge belongs to the band that starts at it), 9.999 in the second, 10 in the third, 13.99 in the fourth, 14 and 25 in the last, a negative figure in the first. Edges 3.5 and 4.25 keep the places they carry in the labels. No edges, a descending pair and a repeated edge are refused. The invested-weighted average: (10 x 0.25 + 30 x -0.05) / 40 = 1 / 40 = 0.025; (1 x 0.1 + 2 x 0.2) / 3 = 0.5 / 3 = 0.1666...; nothing to average and weights that sum to zero give no figure.
